sections.text:
Brunt, 1932. Default parameterization by Jensen et.al., 1990. FAO recommenda-
tion. See also [Kjaersgaard et al., 2007b]
    Used by bioclimate default net radiation (see 19.2, page 115) .
   < brunt (A 0.64 [])
               (B 0.044 [1/sqrt(hPa)]) >
    A: number (dimensionless)
     Parameter (default 0.64)
     Brunt ’A’ parameter (offset).
    B : number [1/sqrt(hPa)]
     Parameter (default 0.044)
     Brunt ’B’ parameter (vapor pressure factor).
